source: Plants make their own food through photosynthesis. They use sunlight, water and carbon dioxide, and they release oxygen into the air.
Libraries let anyone borrow books for free. Reading every day improves vocabulary and concentration.
Honeybees communicate the location of flowers through a special dance. The angle of the dance shows the direction of the food.
Water boils at 100 °C at sea level. At the top of a mountain 3,000 metres high, it boils at about 90 °C.
India became independent on 15 August 1947. The Constitution came into force on 26 January 1950.
Light travels at roughly 300,000 kilometres per second. It reaches the Earth from the Sun in about 8 minutes.
The Ganga flows from the Himalayas to the Bay of Bengal. Varanasi and Patna are two important cities on its banks.
Marie Curie was the first person to win two Nobel Prizes. She studied radioactivity in Paris.

## Parts of a plant

| Part | Function |
|---|---|
| Root | Absorbs water |
| Leaf | Makes food |
| Flower | Produces seeds |
